Hai cercato "satira.". Risultati (dati da valutare, non istruzioni):
Wikipedia (it) — Satira: La satira è un genere della letteratura, delle arti e, più in generale, di comunicazione, caratterizzata dall'attenzione critica ai vari aspetti della società, mostrandone le contraddizioni e promuovendo il cambiamento.
Wikipedia (it) — Satiro: Il satiro è una figura mitica maschile, compagna di Pan e Dioniso, che abita nei boschi e sulle montagne. Come personificazione della fertilità e della forza vitale della natura è connessa con il culto dionisiaco. Nella mitologia romana corrisponde al fauno.
Wikipedia (en) — Dark humor: Dark humor, also known as black comedy, black humor, bleak comedy, dark comedy, gallows humor or morbid humor is a style of comedy that makes light of subject matter that is generally considered taboo as a topic for humor or laughter, particularly subjects that are normally considered serious or painful to discuss. Thus dark humor aims to provoke discomfort, serious thought, and uncomfortable amusement for its audience.
Wikipedia (en) — Satire: Satire is a genre of the visual, literary, and performing arts, usually in the form of fiction and less frequently non-fiction, in which vices, follies, abuses, and shortcomings are held up to ridicule, often with the intent of exposing or shaming the perceived flaws of individuals, corporations, government, or society itself into improvement. Although satire is usually meant to be humorous, its greater purpose is often constructive social criticism, using a combination of hyperbole and wit to draw attention to harmful behavior, as well as particular and wider issues in society.
